titleEn: Minimum Cost to Make Array Equal
title: 使数组相等的最小开销
summary: 把 nums[i] 每增减一需 cost[i]，求把所有数变成同一整数的最小总开销。
insight: 这是加权绝对偏差和，任一加权中位数最优。按数值排序，累计权重达到总权重一半的位置作为目标。
pitfalls: 权重是每单位改动费用
目标不必原先唯一但可取加权中位数

solutions.title: 加权中位数
solutions.idea: 绝对值加权和在权重中位点最小。
steps: totalWeight=sum(cost)，累计到两倍不小于 total 时取 target

code.java: class Solution { public long minCost(int[] nums,int[] cost){Integer[] order=new Integer[nums.length];long total=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){order[i]=i;total+=cost[i];}Arrays.sort(order,Comparator.comparingInt(i->nums[i]));long cumulative=0;int target=0;for(int index:order){cumulative+=cost[index];if(cumulative*2>=total){target=nums[index];break;}}long answer=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++)answer+=Math.abs((long)nums[i]-target)*cost[i];return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minCost(nums:IntArray,cost:IntArray):Long{val order=nums.indices.sortedBy{nums[it]};val total=cost.sumOf{it.toLong()};var cumulative=0L;var target=0;for(index in order){cumulative+=cost[index];if(cumulative*2>=total){target=nums[index];break}};var answer=0L;for(i in nums.indices)answer+=kotlin.math.abs(nums[i].toLong()-target)*cost[i];return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long minCost(vector<int>& nums,vector<int>& cost){vector<int> order(nums.size());iota(order.begin(),order.end(),0);sort(order.begin(),order.end(),[&](int a,int b){return nums[a]<nums[b];});long long total=accumulate(cost.begin(),cost.end(),0LL),cumulative=0;int target=0;for(int index:order){cumulative+=cost[index];if(cumulative*2>=total){target=nums[index];break;}}long long answer=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)nums.size();++i)answer+=llabs((long long)nums[i]-target)*cost[i];return answer;} };
